data.name: Subtitle
data.value: Discover the classics, from Roman pasta to a perfect tiramisu.

data.name: TapHint
data.value: Tap a card to discover the ingredients.

data.name: Footer
data.value: Made with curiosity. Served with amore.

data.name: CarbonaraDescription
data.value: A Roman classic with silky egg sauce, pecorino and crisp guanciale.

data.name: CarbonaraIngredients
data.value: • Spaghetti • Guanciale (cured pork cheek) • Eggs and egg yolks • Pecorino Romano • Black pepper

data.name: CarbonaraTip
data.value: Take the pan off the heat before adding the eggs. A little pasta water helps make a silky sauce.

data.name: PizzaDescription
data.value: Tomato, mozzarella and basil on an airy, golden Neapolitan crust.

data.name: PizzaIngredients
data.value: • Pizza dough: flour, water, yeast and salt • Tomatoes • Fresh mozzarella • Fresh basil • Extra virgin olive oil

data.name: PizzaPreparation
data.value: 30 minutes with ready dough; allow 8–24 hours for the dough to rise.

data.name: PizzaTip
data.value: Preheat the oven and pizza stone thoroughly. A very hot surface helps create a crisp base.

data.name: TiramisuDescription
data.value: Coffee-soaked ladyfingers meet light mascarpone cream and cocoa.

data.name: TiramisuIngredients
data.value: • Savoiardi (ladyfinger biscuits) • Mascarpone • Espresso • Pasteurised eggs • Sugar • Unsweetened cocoa

data.name: TiramisuPreparation
data.value: 30 minutes + at least 4 hours of chilling.

data.name: TiramisuTip
data.value: Dip the biscuits briefly in cooled coffee so they hold their shape. Dust with cocoa just before serving.

data.name: RisottoDescription
data.value: Golden saffron rice, slowly stirred until beautifully creamy.

data.name: RisottoIngredients
data.value: • Carnaroli or Arborio rice • Saffron • Warm stock • Onion • Butter • Parmigiano Reggiano • Dry white wine

data.name: RisottoTip
data.value: Add warm stock one ladle at a time. Stir in butter and parmesan off the heat for a creamy finish.

data.name: LasagneDescription
data.value: Comforting layers of pasta, slow-cooked ragù and creamy béchamel.

data.name: LasagneIngredients
data.value: • Fresh lasagne sheets • Beef and pork ragù • Tomatoes • Onion, carrot and celery • Béchamel: butter, flour and milk • Parmigiano Reggiano

data.name: LasagnePreparation
data.value: About 3 hours including the slow-cooked ragù.

data.name: LasagneTip
data.value: Let the lasagne rest for 10–15 minutes after baking so each slice keeps its layers.
